formula.description: The computation stated explicitly, in terms that resolve to parameters, fields, or constants present in the method body — e.g. 'quantity * unitPrice * (1 + vatRate)'. This is the field that exists because a passing acceptance scenario constrains a formula without stating it.

rounding_mode.description: The rounding applied to the result, verbatim from the source (HALF_UP, FLOOR, ...), or null when the computation does not round. Null means 'this formula does not round', never 'unknown' — an unknowable rounding mode is a confidence < 0.5 escalation, not a null.

scale.description: Decimal places the result is rounded to; null when rounding_mode is null. Stated or null together with rounding_mode — a formula that rounds without saying to what is not a lifted formula.

unrounded_intermediate.description: True when this computation's result is consumed elsewhere at full precision, or when it feeds a column whose scale differs from this formula's. Recorded because that mismatch is exactly the kind of fact that survives every acceptance scenario and then changes the answer in production.

referenced_properties.description: Parameter, field, and constant names present in the method body only.

open_value_domain.description: True when the formula references a set the source does not enumerate (a rate table, a supported-currency list). Not a lift failure — the lift is correct and the set is genuinely absent from the source. Seeds an open-questions entry; see docs/spec-pack.md.
